facts.fact: Aldridge 县警局午后进驻：警长+30 副手——mob 四散、事实军管。
facts.anchor: Aldridge County Sheriff’s Department had rolled into Dunning a little after midday

facts.fact: 医生 Miriam 解镇静给五分钟——之后把丈夫带回来。
被带走地点：加油站——然后一片空白。
facts.anchor: I was at the gas station and then… nothing

facts.fact: 凶手动机直接引语：要让他们付出代价——「水就是生命」。
facts.anchor: He said it’s—it’s to make them pay. ‘That… that water is life.

facts.fact: 「它有能力给予，也有能力夺走——就像他们从我身上夺走的那样。」
facts.anchor: That it has the power to give it, and it has the power to take it away… like they took it from me.

facts.fact: 他指示 Claire 说 Laura 的名字——名单由凶手口述。
Alex 自我认知：她曾就是 Claire——被问着想忘掉的事。
facts.anchor: She’d been Claire Harper. She’d been in that bed.
